name: Women Don't Love || Sumukhi Suresh || New Stand Up Comedy 2020
description:
Hi. I am back again with a new stand up clip about how women don't really love or hate anything. To know why please watch the video and tell me what you pretend to love when someone is worth loving. 

Stream the complete stand up special "DON'T TELL AMMA"
